discoveries: The check flags a line that tells the role to write a path outside the output class, even when the line forbids it. Dropping the path string was enough, and no other text changed.
risks: None known. The reworded line still tells the engineer not to hand-edit the generated copy, and it cites DEC-315. The `four_places` cases will go green only after the copies ACT adds `.claude/skills/<skill>/` at 1.0.1.
lessons: Skill text that forbids a write should not quote the forbidden path, because the output-class check matches path strings and does not read the negation.
proposed_decisions: none
unresolved: none
recommended_next_action: Run the copies ACT to generate `.claude/skills/{backend,api,data,security}/` at 1.0.1, then rerun W2-11 and the lead's `gov skilleval` scenarios.
